newsitem.title: TURKEY: Istanbul gold volume off sharply on higher prices.
newsitem.headline: Istanbul gold volume off sharply on higher prices.

text.p: Traded volume on the Istanbul gold exchange fell to 230 kilos on Thursday from Wednesday's 1,480 as demand faded on higher prices, dealers said.
Gold closed at 1,427,700 lira per gram versus 1,411,500 on Wednesday in line with firmer European levels.
There was no gold trade in dollar terms. Wednesday's close was $350.00 an ounce.
Higher prices also prevented arbitrage, they added.
Of the day's trade, 220 kilos was recorded in the morning session.
